ns2:section.sectionText: Women Interested in Engineering: This course is designed to complement Eng 101 and will provide further discussion of engineering disciplines at Illinois as well as cover topics that are typically introduced to first-year engineering students in orientation courses. Focus will be placed on academic success strategies in technical courses and utilizing University of Illinois resources to enhance your student experience. This course is intended for first-year women students interested in transferring to the College of Engineering from the Division of General Students or other disciplines. Concurrent enrollment in Engineering 101 is expected.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
